statement: let W := fun (z y s : ℕ) => let P := (Finset.Ico z y).filter Nat.Prime; (2:ℤ)-((P.filter (fun p => p∣s)).card:ℤ)-((P.filter (fun p => p^2∣s)).card:ℤ); let A := fun (n z : ℕ) => (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ ¬ (p ∣ n) ∧ ((Finset.Ico 2 z).filter (fun q => Nat.Prime q ∧ q ∣ (n-p))) = ∅); ∀ n : ℕ, 4000000000000000000<n → 30 ∣ n → (n:ℝ)<Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → ∃ z y : ℕ, 2<z ∧ z<y ∧ n≤y^3 ∧ n≤z*y^2 ∧ 0<(∑ p ∈ Finset.filter (fun p => 2≤n-p) (A n z), W z y (n-p))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖第三批 · FR-9018 · 在 D* 上用原加权筛寻求最多两个因子的正余量
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage III · FR-9018 · Seek a positive two-factor margin from the original weighted sieve on D*

brief.zh: 参数可以随 n 变化。验收为同一筛和扣除余项 1 与重复因子后仍为正。FR-9017 将它转成 D* 中每个偶数的 G₂。
brief.en: The parameters may vary with n. Show a positive sum after excluding remainder one and debiting repeated factors with the original weight. FR-9017 then gives G₂ for every even input in D*.
